qualitative.gate_3m_moat_note: Installed base of aseptic carton filling machines provides recurring sleeve demand, but #2 position behind dominant Tetra Pak and dilutive debt-funded M&A (Scholle IPN and Evergreen Asia) destroyed economic returns. Reported GAAP ROIC is 1.2% to 7.0% (5-year median 4.3%), well below the 12% hurdle, culminating in €351M non-recurring impairment charges and a net loss in 2025.
qualitative.note: Fails Gate 3b (ROIC < 12% and lack of pricing power, REJECT). Aseptic carton filling system installed base is overshadowed by Tetra Pak scale dominance and value-destructive M&A (Scholle IPN, Evergreen Asia) that loaded balance sheet with goodwill, resulting in 5-year median GAAP ROIC of 4.3% and a €351M impairment in 2025.
qualitative.evidence: 5-Year median GAAP ROIC is 4.3% (2.3% in 2022, 7.0% in 2023, 6.2% in 2024, and 1.2% in 2025), failing the 12% hurdle. Booked €350.7M in non-recurring impairments and charges in 2025, swinging to a net loss of -€87M. Long-term debt exceeds €2.0B with 2025 interest expense of €111M vs reported EBIT of €64M.
